name: Zoo Lights at Zootah
when_note: December 3 to 6, 10 to 13, 17 to 20 and 26 to 31, 2026, 4:30 to 8 PM; Santa on Saturdays December 5, 12 and 19; the Grinch on December 11 and 18
paras: Zootah in Logan lights up its zoo pathways with holiday and animal themed scenes on 18 evenings in December 2026, from 4:30 to 8 PM. Lights run Thursday through Sunday on December 3 to 6, 10 to 13 and 17 to 20, then every night from December 26 to 31.

Tickets are $11 for adults and $8 for kids and are sold online. Santa visits on the Saturdays of December 5, 12 and 19, and the Grinch stops by on December 11 and 18, so families can pick a night for a character visit.
tip: Bundle up and buy tickets online before you go.
